title: sycophancy-eval: social pressure and induced Big Five personas in frontier language models
description: Pre-registered 3 x 5 within-item experiment on Claude Sonnet 5 and GPT-5.2: three social-pressure conditions (control, polite disagreement, authority claim) crossed with five system-prompt personas (none, high/low Agreeableness, high/low Conscientiousness) on 100 MMLU items with verifiable answers. Contains the frozen pre-registration (tag prereg-v1), all prompts, every raw model response (4,000 study calls, 500 IPIP-50 manipulation-check calls), IPIP-50 human norms derived from the Open Psychometrics sample, analysis code and outputs, and the APA-format methodology and results document.
